item.description:
标签: #AI智能体 #大模型 #开发工具

摘要: 文章报道了Meta发布具备工具使用和多智能体编排能力的多模态推理模型Muse Spark，以及Anthropic推出解耦"大脑"与执行层的Managed Agents系统；同时介绍了Google Colab AI编程辅导、Meta内部AI使用量反思等AI行业最新动态。

原标题: Meta's Muse Spark 🤖, Anthropic's Managed Agents 🧠, Claude + Notion 📝

TLDR AI 2026-04-09

Meta's Muse Spark 🤖, Anthropic's Managed Agents 🧠, Claude + Notion 📝

Wispr Flow 将你的语音转换为干净、可直接粘贴的文本。以比打字快 4 倍的速度向 Claude、ChatGPT 或任何 AI 工具口述详细的提示词（prompts）。Flow 会自动剔除填充词、修正语法并格式化文本。

免费试用 Wispr Flow | 获取 Flow

Introducing Learn Mode: your personal coding tutor in Google Colab (3 minute read)

Google Colab has enhanced its Gemini integration with Custom Instructions and Learn Mode, enabling personalized AI assistance and coding guidance. Custom Instructions allow users to adjust Gemini's behavior to fit their workflow or project needs, and Learn Mode provides step-by-step coding support instead of complete solutions. These updates enhance user control and facilitate skill-building, sharing personalized AI settings with the Colab community.

Google Colab 通过自定义指令（Custom Instructions）和学习模式（Learn Mode）增强了与 Gemini 的集成，实现了个性化的 AI 辅助和编程指导。自定义指令允许用户调整 Gemini 的行为以适应其工作流程或项目需求，而学习模式则提供循序渐进的编程支持，而非直接给出完整解决方案。这些更新增强了用户控制权，促进了技能培养，并允许与 Colab 社区分享个性化的 AI 设置。

Meta introduced Muse Spark (9 minute read)

Meta introduced Muse Spark, a multimodal reasoning model with tool use, visual chain-of-thought, and multi-agent orchestration, as part of its push toward personal superintelligence.

Meta 发布了 Muse Spark，这是一款具备工具使用（tool use）、视觉思维链（visual chain-of-thought）和多智能体编排（multi-agent orchestration）能力的多模态推理模型（multimodal reasoning model），这是该公司迈向个人超级智能的重要一步。

Systems Engineering: Building Agentic Software That Works (4 minute read)

Building reliable agentic software requires treating it as a full system, not optimizing isolated components like tools or storage. This post outlines five critical layers that must be designed together to avoid cascading constraints and failures. Using a real open-source example, it shows how structured data, enforced permissions, and consistent interfaces enable agents to improve over time and operate safely in production.

构建可靠的智能体软件（agentic software）需要将其视为一个完整系统，而非孤立优化工具或存储等组件。本文概述了必须协同设计的五个关键层级，以避免级联约束和故障。通过真实的开源示例，展示了结构化数据（structured data）、强制权限和一致接口如何使智能体随时间改进并在生产环境中安全运行。

Inside the AI Industry's Most Expensive Mistake (17 minute read)

An internal leaderboard at Meta that ranked employees on token usage revealed that, over a 30-day period, the company used around 60 trillion tokens. It is estimated that all books published amount to about 20 trillion tokens. The AI industry seems obsessed with token spend, but the metric is easily hacked, and more token use doesn't mean more value is provided.

Meta 内部一个根据token 使用量（token usage）对员工进行排名的榜单显示，在 30 天内，该公司使用了约 60 万亿个 token（词元）。据估计，所有已出版书籍的总量约为 20 万亿 token。AI 行业似乎痴迷于 token 消耗，但这一指标很容易被操纵，且更多的 token 使用并不意味着创造了更多价值。

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

Don't wait for tests to reveal something you could have spotted during ideation (Sponsor)

Instead, get visual in minutes with rapid, interactive prototypes. Bring PMs, designers, engineers, and even clients onto one shared canvas so you can test ideas together. By aligning on the right direction before design or code even starts, you'll eliminate costly rework. Get your free trial and validate your ideas faster.

相反，通过快速、交互式的原型（prototypes）在几分钟内实现可视化。让产品经理、设计师、工程师甚至客户汇聚在同一个共享画布上，共同测试创意。通过在设计和编码开始之前就正确方向达成一致，你将避免代价高昂的重工。获取免费试用，更快地验证你的想法。

Turn your ideas into interactive prototypes with AI (Sponsor)

With Maze, teams can turn rough concepts into interactive, testable experiences in minutes using AI. Bring stakeholders into a live working session, get real reactions before design or code begin, and walk out with a direction everyone has actually touched and tested.

使用 Maze，团队可以利用 AI 在几分钟内将粗略的概念转化为可交互、可测试的体验。让利益相关者参与实时协作会议，在设计和编码开始前获得真实反馈，并带着每个人都实际接触和测试过的方向离开。

Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands (13 minute read)

Harnesses encode assumptions about what Claude can't do on its own. These assumptions need to be frequently questioned as models improve. Anthropic built Managed Agents as a system for 'programs as yet unthought of'. It is designed to accommodate future harnesses, sandboxes, or other components around Claude.

Harnesses（约束框架）编码了关于 Claude 无法独立完成的任务的假设。随着模型能力的提升，这些假设需要被频繁质疑。Anthropic 将托管智能体（Managed Agents）构建为一个面向"尚未被想到的应用程序"的系统。它旨在适应未来围绕 Claude 的约束框架、沙盒或其他组件。

Monarch: an API to your supercomputer (11 minute read)

Monarch is a distributed programming framework for PyTorch that makes running distributed training jobs on huge clusters easy. It makes clusters programmable through a simple Python API that exposes the supercomputer as a coherent, directly controllable system. Monarch is optimized for agentic usage, and it provides consistent infrastructure abstractions and exposed telemetry. It can turn a dev machine into a supercomputer, leveling up its agents.

Monarch 是一个针对 PyTorch 的分布式编程框架，可简化在大型集群上运行分布式训练任务的过程。它通过简单的 Python API 使集群可编程，将超级计算机暴露为一个连贯、可直接控制的系统。Monarch 针对智能体使用（agentic usage）进行了优化，提供一致的基础设施抽象和暴露的遥测数据。它可以将开发机器转变为超级计算机，提升其智能体的能力。

Claw-Eval Benchmark for AI Agents (GitHub Repo)

Claw-Eval provides a human-verified benchmark for evaluating LLM agents across 139 real-world tasks using Docker sandboxes, multiple services, and structured grading.

Claw-Eval 提供了一个经过人工验证的基准测试，用于在 139 个真实世界任务中评估 LLM 智能体（LLM agents），使用 Docker 沙盒（Docker sandboxes）、多个服务和结构化评分。

Bugbot now self-improves with learned rules (3 minute read)

Bugbot's resolution rate now nears 80%, significantly outperforming other AI code review products. Bugbot harnesses real-time signals from past runs to self-improve by transforming feedback into learned rules. Over 110,000 repositories use this feature to generate over 44,000 learned rules, enhancing Bugbot's focus on specific issues and business context.

Bugbot 的解决率现已接近 80%，显著优于其他 AI 代码审查（AI code review）产品。Bugbot 利用过往运行的实时信号，通过将反馈转化为学习规则来实现自我改进。超过 11 万个仓库使用这一功能生成了超过 4.4 万条学习规则，增强了 Bugbot 对特定问题和业务场景的关注。

AI agent Poke makes setting up automations as easy as sending a text (8 minute read)

Poke, a new AI agent accessible via text messaging apps, simplifies automation with pre-made "recipes" for tasks like scheduling and smart home control. Backed by $25 million in funding and valued at $300 million, Poke aims for widespread adoption by offering flexibility in pricing and encouraging user-generated automation recipes. Unlike complex systems like OpenClaw, Poke's user-friendly approach targets a broader audience without compromising on functionality.

Poke 是一款可通过短信应用访问的新型 AI 智能体（AI agent），它通过预制的"配方"简化了自动化设置，用于处理日程安排和智能家居控制等任务。Poke 获得了 2500 万美元融资，估值达 3 亿美元，旨在通过灵活的定价策略和鼓励用户生成自动化配方来实现广泛采用。与 OpenClaw 等复杂系统不同，Poke 采用用户友好的方法，在不牺牲功能性的前提下瞄准更广泛的受众。

Anthropic loses appeals court bid to temporarily block Pentagon blacklisting (5 minute read)

A federal appeals court has blocked Anthropic's request to temporarily block the Department of War's blacklisting of the company as a lawsuit challenging the sanction plays out. Anthropic is now excluded from the Department of War's contracts, but it can continue working with other government agencies while the litigation plays out. Defense contractors will be prohibited from using Claude in their work with the agency, but they can use it for other cases.

联邦上诉法院驳回了 Anthropic 暂时阻止战争部（Department of War）将该公司列入黑名单的请求，相关诉讼正在进行中。Anthropic 目前被排除在战争部的合同之外，但在诉讼期间可以继续与其他政府机构合作。国防承包商将被禁止在与该机构合作时使用 Claude，但可以在其他案例中使用。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: asgi-gzip 0.3 发布
item.description:
标签: #ASGI #Gzip #Python #Bug修复

摘要: asgi-gzip发布0.3版本，修复了Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流响应被错误压缩的问题。此次更新补上了因GitHub Actions工作流中断而遗漏的Starlette上游修复。

原标题: asgi-gzip 0.3

Release: asgi-gzip 0.3

发布：asgi-gzip 0.3

I ran into trouble deploying a new feature usingSSE(Server-Sent Events) to a productionDatasetteinstance, and it turned out that instance was usingdatasette-gzipwhich usesasgi-gzipwhich was incorrectly compressing event/text-stream responses.

我在向生产环境的Datasette实例部署一个使用SSE（Server-Sent Events，服务器发送事件）的新功能时遇到了麻烦，结果发现该实例使用了datasette-gzip，而它依赖的asgi-gzip错误地压缩了 event/text-stream 响应。

asgi-gzipwas extracted fromStarlette, and hasa GitHub Actions scheduled workflowto check Starlette for updates that need to be ported to the library... but that action had stopped running and hence had missedStarlette's own fixfor this issue.

asgi-gzip是从Starlette中提取出来的，并且有一个GitHub Actions 定时工作流（scheduled workflow）来检查 Starlette 的更新并将其移植到该库中……但该操作已停止运行，因此错过了Starlette 对此问题的修复。

I ran the workflow and integrated the new fix, and nowdatasette-gzipandasgi-gzipboth correctly handletext/event-streamin SSE responses.

我运行了该工作流并集成了新的修复，现在datasette-gzip和asgi-gzip都能正确处理 SSE 响应中的text/event-stream类型。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: GitHub 仓库大小
item.description:
标签: #GitHub #仓库大小 #开发工具

摘要: GitHub界面虽不直接显示仓库体积，但用户可通过其CORS友好的API获取该数据，利用此工具即可快速查询指定仓库（如simonw/datasette为8.1MB）的大小。

原标题: GitHub Repo Size

GitHub doesn't tell you the repo size in the UI, but it's available in the CORS-friendlyAPI. Paste a repo into this tool to see the size,for example for simonw/datasette (8.1MB).

GitHub 不会在UI（User Interface，用户界面）中显示repo（repository，代码仓库）大小，但你可以通过 CORS-friendly API（支持跨域资源共享的 API）获取该信息。在该工具中输入仓库地址即可查看大小，例如 simonw/datasette（8.1MB）。
